stem:
The Leija family is on a road trip. The number line represents the distance the family drove on Monday from their home to point A.

About how many miles did the family drive on Monday?

options.label: A
options.text: 300, because point A is less than halfway between 300 and 400

options.label: B
options.text: 500, because point A is more than halfway between 300 and 500

options.label: C
options.text: 200, because point A is less than halfway between 200 and 400

options.label: D
options.text: 400, because point A is more than halfway between 300 and 400

visual_elements: Number line from 0 miles to 600 miles, marked in increments of 100. Point A is marked at 375 miles, between 300 and 400, closer to 400.
difficulty_rationale: The problem requires reading a number line and estimating distance, a single straightforward reasoning step for grade 3.
